decisions.decision: Use one persistent content-addressed blob store with a 16 GiB default hard ceiling.
decisions.rationale: Unifies temporary verification, reusable reads, writable data and publication ownership under one physical-byte budget.

decisions.decision: Keep the decoded-manifest in-memory LRU separate.
decisions.rationale: It caches bounded decoded control-plane objects, not raw blob bytes.

decisions.decision: Chunk NAR uploads during PUT and reuse those chunks for overlay and publication.
decisions.rationale: Avoids retaining and rereading a second complete NAR representation.
The internal persistent BlobStore replaces external cache mirroring.

decisions.decision: Do not rewrite the existing de3d233 prerequisite commit.
decisions.rationale: It already contains the verified compatibility fix and shared history must remain intact.
